answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can act, and make bond size climb with each new identity a single funding source spawns. A lone operator trying to whisper a thousand fake agents into the network must lock capital that grows from onyx-dark cheap to a heavy umber tier, so the cost of faking many identities outruns any reward. Honest agents reclaim their bond; sybils forfeit it on detection.
